metadata.description: Agent skills for Salesforce teams - packaged expert know-how for AI coding agents, from DevOps to development and testing.

plugins.name: devops-builder
plugins.description: Design, set up and maintain a Salesforce CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions with the Salesforce DevOps Starter Kit.

plugins.name: devops-operator
plugins.description: Guided day-to-day work on a Salesforce project in Git and GitHub - branches, retrieves, commits, pull requests and promotions - for every team member.

plugins.name: e2e-automator
plugins.description: Write, run and maintain end-to-end UI tests for Salesforce Lightning with UTAM - from a user story to a green, stable test, and through every Salesforce release.

plugins.name: lwc-crafter
plugins.description: Build, fix, review and set up Lightning Web Components with the Awesome LWC Collection's practices - reuse first, platform data, secure by default, tested and accessible - with a guard that checks every component file as it is written.

plugins.name: demo-designer
plugins.description: Design and record polished demo videos of Salesforce orgs, apps and sites - scripted click paths with cursor, captions, intro and outro cards, transitions and subtitles - for bids and pitches, sprint reviews, release teasers and training.

plugins.name: multi-framework-wizard
plugins.description: Design, build, embed, review and fix Salesforce Multi-Framework applications the way Polyglot Arcade does - React and Angular UI bundles, Lightning web components and externally hosted apps on one org's data, composed on Lightning pages as microfrontends, with Agentforce where it helps.
